_comment: Compound threat recipes. These fire when several weak/strong signals combine, so robbery does not depend on a lone gun detection in low-quality CCTV.

rules.name: armed_robbery
rules.title: ARMED ROBBERY IN PROGRESS
rules.gate_question: Do these frames show an armed robbery or coercive threat in progress: a weapon shown, staff/customers forced or fleeing, a counter rushed, or a person forced to the ground?

rules.name: violent_theft
rules.title: VIOLENT THEFT / GRAB-AND-RUN
rules.gate_question: Do these frames show theft escalating to force or a grab-and-run: concealment or grabbing goods combined with a shove, struggle, or someone fleeing?
